readings.moment: Lina came down into the kitchen (thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
Madame's piano began (two minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
Madame's piano stopped (eleven minutes past eleven by the kitchen clock)
The temple struck eleven, which Lina stayed past
The kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven when the hall clock struck eleven

durations: Lina's arrival in the kitchen to the start of the piano: eleven minutes (10:47 to 10:58 by the kitchen clock)
The piano playing: thirteen minutes (10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock)
From the piano stopping to the hall clock striking eleven: two minutes (11:11 to 11:13 by the kitchen clock)
whereabouts: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen.
Fräulein Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
Fräulein Lina sat by the stove in the kitchen.
Madame was playing the piano (the Chopin) while Lina was with Rosa in the kitchen.
Madame's piano was two floors away from the kitchen.
Rosa heard the hall clock strike eleven.
Rosa went up the stairs to fetch the master when it was time for the toast.
Rosa found the master on the floor of the atelier, by his bench.
Rosa went down the stairs from the atelier and could not speak for a while.
Rosa did not touch the master.
